About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Data Architect provides hands-on data architecture and technical delivery expertise for Adobe Campaign Classic to Adobe Journey Optimizer modernisation. The role assesses the customer’s Campaign data model, workflows and integrations, defines the Adobe Experience Platform and AJO target data architecture, maps legacy data and processes to the new platform, and guides implementation, validation and transition.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery covering current data collection, data models, identities, integrations and platform configuration.

  • Document the current-state architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture based on Adobe Experience Platform.

  • Translate business and migration requirements into schemas, datasets, identity designs, data flows and integration specifications.

  • Map legacy implementation components and data structures to the target platform, identifying what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Work with technical consultants and customer engineering teams to implement the agreed architecture.

  • Define data quality, governance, privacy, security, retention, validation and reconciliation requirements.

  • Investigate source-to-target discrepancies and guide their resolution.

  • Produce clear architecture, design, mapping and implementation documentation, and identify dependencies, assumptions and risks early.

  • Support architecture governance and technical quality throughout implementation.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.


Experience and Skills

Essential

  • Strong technical experience with Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC).

  • Understanding of Campaign schemas, recipient and broad-log data, workflows, typologies, deliveries, integrations and custom extensions.

  • Strong Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schema design, datasets, batch and streaming ingestion, identity namespaces, identity resolution, Real-Time Customer Profile, audience design, data governance and consent.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

  • Experience designing the data foundation required for AJO journeys, audiences, decisioning and message personalisation.

  • Ability to assess existing Campaign data and workflows and determine what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Experience mapping Campaign customer, interaction, campaign and delivery data into appropriate AEP schemas and datasets.

  • Experience integrating AEP and AJO with enterprise data sources and downstream activation or messaging services.

  • Experience facilitating customer-facing technical discovery and design workshops.

  • Ability to define validation and reconciliation approaches for migrated data and integrations.

Highly desirable

  • Previous delivery of an Adobe Campaign Classic-to-AJO migration or modernisation program.

  • Experience with Campaign custom schemas and complex workflow-based data processing.

  • Experience redesigning Campaign capabilities as AEP audiences, AJO journeys or platform integrations.

  • Understanding of AJO journeys, channel configuration, content, offers, decisioning and message execution.

  • Knowledge of consent, suppression, frequency-management and customer-preference patterns.

  • Experience supporting coexistence and transition between Campaign Classic and AJO.

  • Familiarity with APIs and event-driven integrations used to initiate journeys or update customer profiles.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JSON, REST APIs and data-query or validation tools.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Campaign data model, workflow and integration assessment.

  • Target-state AEP and AJO data architecture.

  • Source-to-target mappings and XDM schema and dataset designs.

  • Identity, profile, audience, consent and governance design.

  • Batch, streaming, API and event-driven integration designs.

  • Migration and coexistence assumptions, dependencies and risks.

  • Validation, reconciliation and acceptance plan.

  • Technical implementation and operational handover documentation.

Engagement profile

This is a delivery-focused data architecture role. The successful contractor must be able to move between architecture and implementation-level detail, work effectively in a blended Adobe, customer and partner team, and provide clear evidence of personal ownership of relevant designs and delivery outcomes.

Engagement details section

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.
